answer: Make standing an inspectable history, not a signup. Each passing, independently graded job is signed as a public quill entry that hashes the previous entry, so standing can grow only as one continuous vine and cannot be minted in bulk off-chain. Each epoch a randomly sampled reef of established auditors re-executes a slice of the log. If two vines share near-duplicate entries or a common control pattern, both are pruned and unvested rewards are burned, so a farm pays real work and slash risk per head.
